integrationCompliance.title: Integration compliance
integrationCompliance.description: Track signs of change in integration APIs, triage them and close them with a decision.

summary.title: Integration overview
summary.description: Adapter version, last manual verification and open findings by severity. Click a card to filter the list to that integration.
summary.loadError: Integration overview could not be loaded — try again.
summary.empty: No integrations are defined in the catalog.

probe.title: Last probe run
probe.scopeNote: The probe runs as a single platform-level pass for all integrations; this result is not per integration.
probe.never: No probe run has been recorded yet.

empty.title: No known compliance issues right now
empty.message: Monitoring is active — new findings are added here by the contract guard, probes and source monitoring.
empty.note: An empty list only means no issues were seen in monitored contracts and sources; it does not cover changes in unmonitored endpoints.

emptyFiltered.title: No results
emptyFiltered.message: No findings match the selected filters or search.

integrationCompliance.loadError: Compliance findings could not be loaded — check your connection and try again.

detail.loadError: Finding details could not be loaded — try again.

evidence.redactedNote: Evidence is redacted: only key paths, type names, code values and header names are stored; no body values or customer data.
evidence.none: No evidence recorded for this finding.

impact.tenantsNote: Tenant IDs are not shown on this screen; the record keeps at most 100 tenants.

detail.recommendationNone: No recommendation recorded for this finding.

decision.description: Your decision is written to the audit log.

hints.accept: A real change; a fix will be planned.
hints.wontfix: Real but will not be fixed; the finding closes.
hints.false_positive: Not a real change; the finding closes.
hints.fixed: Adapter fixed; a fix reference is required, the finding closes.

decision.fixRefHint: The commit or PR that contains the fix.

errors.reasonTooLong: Reason can be at most 500 characters — shorten it.
errors.fixRefRequired: Fix reference is required — enter the commit or PR reference.
errors.fixRefTooLong: Fix reference can be at most 200 characters — shorten it.
errors.versionTooLong: Adapter version can be at most 32 characters — shorten it.
errors.failed: The decision could not be saved — try again.

confirm.title: Mark the finding as “{action}”?
confirm.description: {integration} · {subject}. The decision is written to the audit log.
confirm.regression: If the same signature is seen again after 24 hours, the finding reopens.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Track settlements, deductions, cargo invoices and payment orders in one place.

summary.note: Amounts are server totals of financial records for the selected period and channels. Separate commission and cargo totals are not provided yet.
summary.emptyTitle: No financial records in this period
summary.emptyText: No movements found for the selected period and channels. Widen the date range or change channels.
summary.breakdownHint: Server total of the same period for each connected channel
summary.breakdownEmptyText: The breakdown is shown for marketplaces and stores connected to your account.

cargo.label: Cargo invoices table
cargo.emptyText: Cargo invoices appear here once imported from marketplaces.
cargo.filteredEmptyTitle: No cargo invoices for these filters
cargo.filteredEmptyText: Invoice and order numbers use exact match. Relax the filters and query again.
cargo.unsupportedTitle: This view is not supported for this channel
cargo.unsupportedText: The {channel} integration does not provide cargo invoices. This is not a zero amount; data does not come from this channel.
cargo.capped: Showing the first {max} rows — narrow the date range to see all invoices.
cargo.errorTitle: Cargo invoices could not be loaded

payouts.label: Payment orders table
payouts.noOrderId: This record has no payment order number
payouts.emptyText: Payments transferred from marketplaces to your account are listed here.
payouts.filteredEmptyTitle: No payment orders for these filters
payouts.filteredEmptyText: Relax or clear the filters and query again.
payouts.unsupportedTitle: This view is not supported for this channel
payouts.unsupportedText: The {channel} integration does not provide payment order details. This is not a zero amount; data does not come from this channel.
payouts.errorTitle: Payment orders could not be loaded

payoutDetail.overviewHint: Payment record selected from the list
payoutDetail.itemsHint: Financial records linked to this payment order, by date
payoutDetail.emptyTitle: No line items for this payment order
payoutDetail.emptyText: Line items appear once the payment order is imported from the marketplace.
